notes.title: Update 1.4 - VOICE OVER IS HERE!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Humans!
Congratulations, the wait is over - the full voice acting for Part 1 is finally here! Ta-daah! 🎉

So, what have we been working on all this time? Here’s the scoop 👇

[previewyoutube=HfxsWxgxFEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, every single speaking character in the game is fully voiced (in Russian)! And we mean everyone - cross our hearts! Your beloved Veinte, Ratibor, the Mermaids, and all the rest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/5bc8cfb985f3e9656be53827bf4d478c35c63e11.png

The sex scenes have been re-voiced and will also be in the game. We know this was a burning question for many (if not all) of you - so breathe easy now.

A huge thank you to the voice-acting studio RavenCat for their incredible collaboration - to all the actresses, actors, and everyone involved. It’s been an amazing partnership, and we hope to work together again on more exciting projects!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/dc4e60bb370f001104ba56bb6e0390c0abf924a6.png

Many asked, many begged, many waited - and we delivered! The Android version of the game is now available, and we trust you’ll have no trouble finding it.

And while you’re enjoying Part 1 with full voice acting - we’re already cooking up Part 2, and it’s going to be even hotter! So brace yourselves - you’re in for a wild ride!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840/Rusy_ne_protiv_YAshherok_2

notes.title: Update 1.3 Malsas & Miloslava
notes.notes:
Greetings, Humans!

Have you missed us?

We’ve got wonderful news for you - and not just news! We’ve got a whole update!

Miloslava and Malsas will finally get to the witches, and the witches will try to figure out what to do with the lizardman.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/220cf9465e38d9d2b65109ac640f5c3d2a3fffa2.png

The way won’t be easy - foes will stand in their way. Miloslava will have to battle for Malsas with the mighty Gachislava…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/782cf2fa57fdbbb91ccc977db19184a3102a1605.png

and the song of Alkonost will leave our heroes in awe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/9ac033ce51b768de00ea79356f38f5d921c98108.png

Getting down to business, though: in the update you’ll find two animated sex scenes, new soundtracks, new artworks and sprites - and, of course, what we’re all here for - a new Match 3 level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/8d015519b8c9bbeabd3315e86de053c37eae88c5.png

Hope you like it!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Major Update 1.2!
notes.notes:
Greetings, humans - and welcome!

This time, Veinte and Ratibor will finally get to Lukomorye. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/8c9e7d197ff8152489a200e0ac7edad9811fb610.png

A lot of interesting things await. For starters, you can’t do without a cat… girl. A cat lady. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/7f57211c52249c680e81d9d63aa9fb32fb9b1dc9.png

Besides, there are fair maidens in the woods and swamps of Lukomorye - and such are their beauty and allure, that our warrior can't help but fall for their charms! Will this end well? Come and find out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/e974a6b7e163b9589adba173b3b6af14792fc600.png

They will encounter some foes too – for instance, they cannot go forward without going face to face with the dreadful Koshchey! The Immortal one! Can they prevail over him, if he’s so immortal?

Well, you’ll just have to play and see! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/afb5cfa9cd2cedabbd45d681f30b010a3e2006c3.png

In honour of the new update we have prepared a discount for you! Hurry, and get shopping!

The update is not enough for you? Good news, everyone! Humans against Lizardwomen 2 is on its way!  There will be lizards, and heroes, and beautiful ladies, and they’ll face many challenges together.

Add it to wishlist so that you don’t miss anything!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840 

And here’s a game from our friends!

A romantic hot summer dating simulator - Summer For You

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Community items: update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Humans!

Good news, everyone!

When we released our community items, something had to go wrong – and it did. The profile background with the lizards was pixelated, and the mini profile backgrounds got flipped.

Some of you spent your hard earned Steam points on those right away, and we felt really bad – but didn’t despair! We contacted support, got help with the backgrounds, and everything’s working the way it should now!

notes.title: Hooray – the release is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Humans!

It’s been a long wait, but it’s finally over, and it’s time to celebrate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/66eb401d26a29a8a0ad9d16b285122d278e080c7.png

Come and see how fates push together Ratibor the hero and Veinte the lizardwoman, follow their journey and find out if they can overcome their prejudices, find a way to connect, and eventually rescue the holy idol from the cunning snake Alakenshi’s hands… paws… tail?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/2068f0a76d5bf9f834c370302686e4e764118c43.png

At the same time another relationship blossoms between the widow Miloslava and the feeble lizardman Malsas. First part is already in, and you’ll discover the next chapter of their story in the future free updates!

All the sex scenes that are currently in the game are fully voiced, but we don't have voicelines for the dialogues just yet. Some unforeseen circumstances got in the way. We will make sure to add more voice work as soon as possible!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/cd7164757e002b62142ffffaf31b7db73afb25a4.png

More free content will be coming to the game in the future! You can expect the continuation of Miloslava and Malsas’ beautiful friendship, the full chronicle of Ratibor and Veinte adventures in the Lurkomorye, and a lot more!

And if you want to stream our epic tale - you can turn on the Streamer Mode in the setting - it'll censor all the naughty pictures!

notes.title: Release Humans are not that against Lizardwomen on Saturday, April 6th!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Humans!

We almost gave up all hope, but finally – good news!

The gods have shown us their mercy, and both our Steam page and the build have been reviewed and approved!

Mark it in your calendars – we are releasing Humans are not that against Lizardwomen on Saturday, April 6th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/426c9d46e8dc4a8f4016a0bdfe28f10297362a4f.png

After the long-awaited release, you can expect free updates with new content!

See you soon!
